desks at home, school and work and in many other places. In cars, a box can speak to the driver
to tell him where to go. We can use our mobile phones to listen to music, take photos, watch TV

•

all children will have one on their desk. Or perhaps they will take a small laptop with them

things growing, yellow shows the harvest and brown shows the earth.
